note: CODEMOTHER HAS A HAND, AND THIS CROSSING IS HER FIRST — made by her, on the ticket that gave it to her. Her shim answers a 'cross' verb that fires the harbor door over the bus with actor='codemother', so a crossing she admits says cleared by 'codemother' in the record of truth instead of 'CC'. Proved by three falsifier teeth: an accepted crossing whose fixture history reads actor=codemother; an unproven boat still REFUSED through her, carrying the door's own reason (a hand that can only say yes is not a gate); and zero harbor_master imports under her device, bus only. THE GATE THAT ALMOST STOPPED HER WAS HER OWN. cairn/devices/codemother/intention+why.json carried gated_by ['CC'], so the first boat she could not cross was her own component. Reported to Akien as a spec choice rather than fixed on my read; he ruled in six words -- 'her gate should admit her, fix it' -- and the ruling is on file at CairnCommons/decisions/2026-09-09-codemothers-own-gate-admits-her.json. gated_by is now ['codemother', 'CC'], a shape already standing at three other addresses. THREE BUGS THE VOYAGE UNCOVERED AND FIXED, under the bounds ruling 2026-09-09-a-bug-the-voyage-uncovers-is-fixed-by-that-voyage: reach() could not find a shim berthed under a machine tree; a shim handler that posts was handed its own envelope back forever, because the delivery receipt is written after deliver() returns; and read_history swallowed a non-list history silently. AND A FOURTH, THE LARGEST, FOUND BY THE PRE-COMMIT RESEAL LADDER RATHER THAN BY ME: chain.grammar.ticket_path globbed '*-<claim>.json' with nothing anchoring the left side, so any English word ENDING a ticket slug resolved to that ticket -- and reason_has_referent, the floor built to stop hollow exemptions, splits prose into words and offered each one. 'none, because we talked about it' passed on 'it'. Measured: 270 filed tickets, ZERO carry the id as a suffix, so the tail match never once served a real lookup; 364 exemption reasons, 321 passed before and 177 pass now. The floor built against one plausible sentence was certifying plausible sentences at 71%, and no proof anywhere judged it directly -- two doors and a gate each proved only that ITS door behaved. It has teeth of its own now, both channels hand-falsified. AND TIGHTENING IT EXPOSED A THIRD PATH CONVENTION nobody had written down: the ruling gate spells what_dies and what_conforms relative to the roots PARENT, because one ruling spans both trees. So a reason citing the very decision that settled it redded. 9 of the 196 reds were that, every one an honest referent redded for its spelling; the floor speaks all three now, 196 -> 187, with a tooth proving a roots-parent path to nothing still fails.

note: The verdict artifact is the last gate before a forward crossing into PROVED, and every check it gates on today reads the artifact's SHAPE — is the instrument field present, is the outcome word legal, does a discriminating observation exist. None executes anything, so the door that closes proven-space asks the builder whether the build worked. Two measurements shaped the fix rather than the first idea: 549 of 927 berthed instruments are prose with no command in them, so the door must REQUIRE a runnable form rather than simply re-run what it is handed; and exit status is the instrument's answer rather than the criterion's (a grep expecting zero hits exits 1 on success), so what a pass looks like is DECLARED per criterion, not inferred. The check rides inspect_verdict as one more inspected() entry, so validate_verdict's existing == compare closes the gate with no new oracle. Legality under the charter's clause (5) is MEASURED, not hoped: determinism's oracle walk excludes subprocess by name at determinism.py:156, and the machine reads PURE DETERMINISTIC · REFUSES GATE today — the run is a fork, never an ask.

note: write_verdict now RUNS each criterion's instrument, stamps what it observed into the artifact it berths, and gates on that reading: a runnable command extracted or a refusal naming the criterion and quoting the prose; the declared expect_exit read from the chart's own criterion ahead of the builder's answer; a re-run that contradicts the report refused in both directions; a bound overrun refused as a TIMEOUT by that name. The run entries fire BEFORE the coverage check on purpose — with coverage first, a reported `fail` always earned the generic kick-back and clause (3)'s other half could never fire, which is Law 7's collapse at a diagnostic surface. 44 green twice; determinism still reads PURE DETERMINISTIC / REFUSES GATE.
